required_manual_checks.description: Reproduce makeReceipt() rejecting local-pg17 with invalid receipt input. The reported failure occurred during receipt generation on the exact combined 2A.2d tree ae43f194fda5c1bed4bcb67afd7ac3e926b132fe; do not treat a partial proof run as a pass.

Add regression coverage proving a local-pg17 receipt is created and verifies successfully. Check that all classes currently emitted by environmentClass() are accepted: static-local, local-render, production-startup, production-database, local-pg17, local-pglite, isolated-fixture-recovery, and owner-artifact-recovery. Prefer validation aligned with this finite set.

Keep malformed and unexpected environment-class names rejected; test representative invalid strings, including arbitrary digit-bearing names. Preserve receipt verification against the expected environment class.

Preserve receipt tree/SHA binding, HMAC behavior, phase separation, suite and test binding, and existing proof requirements. Do not change manifest classifications or permit missing, skipped, failed, stale, or tampered proof to pass.

Run the focused architecture gate-proof tests and typecheck on the exact candidate tree; record commands and outcomes for Claude review. Freeze and publish the exact candidate through Coordinator for Claude review.

Diff is limited to apps/os/scripts/gate-proof.mjs and apps/os/tests/architecture/gate-proof.test.ts. Do not edit 2A.2d Sales code, DB tests, production data, migrations, manifest classifications, Coordinator, or unrelated proof infrastructure. Do not weaken or bypass any proof requirement.

title: Allow legitimate DB proof environment classes
